sourceFacts.basis: Coastal Safety Directorate publishes30m three-stage masonry tower and58m light elevation. Its opposed day/night and aerial photographs constrain stage proportions, white masonry, narrow stair windows, lantern and characteristic cage/antenna ensemble. OSMtower way1035459712 supplies the8.9x8.54m octagonal ground envelope; photographed stage proportions are13.5m combined lower tiers and11.3m upper shaft. Radar extension is photo-proportioned above the published tower height. OSM outlines are approximate map evidence, not an engineering survey. Mapped8.9x8.54m base is preserved without stretching; ordinary plinth/cornice overhangs remain outside it. Operator30m tower height is separate from58m light elevation. Radar/antenna33.8m top and individual tier heights/window allocation/hardware are photographic proportions. Operator-published equipment configuration is represented; completed restoration replacement equipment has not been independently documented. Adjacent keeper/tomb-front buildings, mosque and modern control tower are host map structures; tower interior/optic operation and exact inscriptions are omitted. No footprint replacement; host terrain supplies cliff height.

appearance.identity: White three-stage octagonal masonry tower on its mapped eight-sided base, narrow staggered staircase windows, projecting zinc-colored stage caps, railed gallery, small clear lantern on tapering service drum, conical cap, tall four-legged external antenna cage, caged ladder, red radar array and exterior cable.
appearance.master: Original21710-triangle master is preserved exactly; reviewed master repairs inward winding of all octagonal footing/tier/cornice/gallery surfaces without changing envelope or wall/opening orientation.
appearance.browser: Four separate levels retain all three masonry stages, western inset entrance, gallery, lantern, four-legged open antenna cage, ladder and radar mast/array. District reduces circular subdivisions, optic ribs, ladder rungs and gallery pickets.
